Upper Text: Digivolve: 1 from [RizeGreymon][When Digivolving] You may play 1 yellow or red Tamer card from your hand without paying its memory cost. Then, if [RizeGreymon] or [X Antibody] is in this Digimon’s digivolution cards, 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -2000 DP for the turn for each yellow or red Tamer you have in play. [Your Turn] For each Tamer you have in play, this Digimon gets +1000 DP.
